name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace. There is no JavaScript in this repo; these scripts are named entry points for the stdlib-only Python/shell self-checks, so agents, contributors and CI all invoke the same commands. See .github/workflows/ci.yml for what each script checks and why.

scripts.lint: python3 -m compileall -q sim design layout signoff && bash -n sim/selftest.sh && python3 design/netlist.py --lint
scripts.check:spec: python3 sim/tools/jitter_energy_law.py --check && python3 sim/tools/starved_cell_jitter_energy.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_sizing.py --check && python3 sim/tools/worst_corner_entropy.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_coupling_variants.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_coupling_buffer_variant.py --check && python3 sim/tools/liveness_tap_phase_variants.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_liveness_tap_phase_variants.py --check && python3 sim/tools/sampler_bit_bias_variants.py --check && python3 sim/tools/time_to_first_valid.py --check && python3 sim/tools/power_rollup.py --check && python3 sim/tools/digital_corner_characterization.py --check && python3 sim/tools/vss_trunk_ir_drop.py --check && python3 sim/tools/corpus_counts.py --check && python3 sim/tools/klt_pin_sites.py --check && python3 sim/tools/jitter_estimator_calibration_check.py --check && python3 sim/tools/statistical_battery.py --check
scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:layout && npm run check:spec && npm run check:regmap && npm run check:floorplan-netlist && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:digital-input && npm run check:layout && npm run check:floorplan && npm run check:signoff && npm run check:evidence-history && npm run check:no-host-paths && sim/selftest.sh
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:layout && npm run check:spec && npm run check:regmap && npm run check:floorplan-netlist && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:evidence-history && npm run check:no-host-paths && npm run check:netlist && npm run check:digital-netlist && npm run check:digital-input && npm run check:digital-sdf && python3 layout/verify.py --require-tools && python3 layout/floorplan/floorplan.py --require-tools && python3 signoff/check.py --require-tools && sim/selftest.sh --require-pdk
